intro.title: Discover El Oso y el Madroño
intro.description: El Oso y el Madroño is one of Madrid's most iconic monuments. Located in the famous Puerta del Sol, this symbol represents the city's coat of arms and is a must-visit meeting point for locals and tourists alike.

knowledge.title: About El Oso y el Madroño

sections.title: Historical Background
sections.content: El Oso y el Madroño is a bronze sculpture created by artist Antonio Navarro Santafé in 1967. It represents the coat of arms of Madrid, showing a bear feeding on the fruits of a strawberry tree (madroño). The current statue is the third version, installed in its current location in 2009.

sections.title: Symbolism
sections.content: The bear and the strawberry tree are the central elements of Madrid's coat of arms. The bear represents the abundance of wildlife in the forests that surrounded the original city, while the strawberry tree (madroño) is a common species in the Community of Madrid region.

sections.title: Location
sections.content: The sculpture is situated in Puerta del Sol, specifically next to the General Directorate of Police building. It is one of the most popular meeting points in Madrid and a must-stop for tourists.

sections.title: Cultural Significance
sections.content: El Oso y el Madroño is much more than a sculpture; it is a symbol of identity for Madrid's residents. It appears on the official coat of arms of the city and is mentioned in various literary and cultural works related to Madrid.

sections.title: Visiting Information
sections.content: The sculpture can be visited at any time, as it is located in an outdoor public space. Puerta del Sol is accessible 24 hours a day and is well connected by public transportation.

items.text: An iconic symbol of Madrid. Whenever I visit Puerta del Sol, I have to take a photo with the bear and the strawberry tree. It's a classic.

items.name: Lucía R.
items.text: Impossible to visit Madrid and not pass by El Oso y el Madroño. It's the meeting point par excellence and a mandatory photo.
